source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-8

procedures.title: Parking lamp bulb replacement
steps: (Continued) Change the bulb, check that the lamp works, then refit the lens and screws.

procedures.title: Parking lamp housing replacement
steps: Take out the 4 screws holding the radiator grille to the body.
Lift the grille out and remove the 2 nuts securing the lamp to the grille.
Unplug the lamp lead from the front wiring harness.
Move the lens and bulb to the new housing.
Mount the lamp in the grille with the 2 nuts.
Plug in the lamp lead and refit the grille.

procedures.title: Front side marker lamp replacement
steps: Take out the 4 grille-to-body screws and swing the grille aside to reach the marker lamp nuts.
Remove the retaining nuts from inside the fender.
Pull the lamp out of the fender and unplug it.
Plug the lamp in and fit the lamp and bezel into the fender.

procedures.title: Front side marker lamp bulb replacement
steps: Remove the grille screws and swing the grille to one side.
Reach through the grille opening, turn the plug connector 1/4 turn counterclockwise and pull it out; the bulb is held in the plug.
Change the bulb and refit the plug.
